name: Desync Playground
desc:
Built in visualizer, client & server, with customization, ingame server-side and client-side position, rotation and velocity displays. As well as other features to help with debugging desync scripts/cheats. R15 and R6 Supported 

Suggest features through my roblox Messages

[2.8.4 CHANGELOGS]
Fixed the position for the serverside exec button & watermark position on mobile
Improved the mobile support on the serverside exec | use the executor button to toggle
Added text to indicate the devices in the choosing screen in case images dont load
